invariance_check.comparison_set: same frozen dev rows and same raw RF scores
invariance_check.observed_explanation: Isotonic is non-decreasing rather than strictly increasing; it creates tied score blocks. With zero inversions, any AUC change is due to ties, not reordered pairs.

conclusion: The original calibrators were fitted on grouped OOF train predictions and evaluated on separate dev rows; no same-sample calibration evaluation was found. The isotonic AUC difference is attributable to tied score blocks and must not be described as improved discrimination without the cross-fit evidence.
